description.value: Amici is a modern Italian wine bar in downtown Abbotsford celebrating the Italian tradition of gathering around food, wine, and conversation. The restaurant operates two concepts under one roof — an osteria-style main room and a Piccolo Pizzeria — with a curated Italian-inspired wine list and a members-only Supper Club launching in 2026. It's a sit-down destination well suited for a post-ride meal or a longer evening stop in the Fraser Valley.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 37m; rack (3 spaces) at 64m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at amiciwinebar.com is fully accessible and confirms the business is an active Italian wine bar and restaurant with pickup ordering available. The OSM community field says 'Chilliwack' but the website clearly states 'Abbotsford, BC V2S 2G9', and the OSM name differs from the website's self-identification ('Amici Italian Wine Bar'). No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site; only pickup ordering is confirmed.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Chilliwack' but the website and address clearly place this business in Abbotsford, BC — the OSM community tag is incorrect.
OSM name is 'Amici Wine Bar Osteria & Enoteca' but the website consistently uses 'Amici Italian Wine Bar' (and 'Amici Italian Wine Bar & Piccolo Pizzeria') — possible rebrand or OSM entry outdated.
OSM has no phone number; (778) 201-0023 is taken from the website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service Italian restaurant in downtown Abbotsford with dine-in and pickup options; a legitimate food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley, pending confirmation of bike parking.
